title: FLATTERY IN MOTION: BENCHMARKING AND ANALYZING SYCOPHANCY IN VIDEO-LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on sycophancy as a behavior affecting factual consistency and trustworthiness in Video-LLMs. While sycophancy is a behavioral flaw, the benchmark evaluates model performance on video reasoning tasks (causal, temporal, descriptive) under misleading prompts rather than evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
